class Person {
 name: String
 age: Int
 hidden concealed: String = throw("hidden forced")
 local secret = throw("local forced")
 function method(): Int = throw("method forced")
}
hidden mapped = Map("name", "Pigeon").toTyped(Person)
hidden dynamic = new Dynamic { name = "Pigeon"; extra = throw("extra forced") }.toTyped(Person)
hidden badValue = Map("name", 1, "age", "bad").toTyped(Person)
hidden wrongKeys = Map(1, "value").toTyped(Person)
